prediction.likelyOutcome: Landlord should prevail on liability essentially without contest and recover the unpaid rent/additional rent plus deposit-replenishment amounts it pled, roughly in the $800,000-$3.25 million band depending on how the deposit-replenishment theory and any mitigation offset shake out at trial; the actual trial award will likely run somewhat higher than the pled $3,238,504.15 once additional rent that accrued between the complaint and trial is added, but that increment isn't quantifiable from this record.

outcome.description: After a non-jury trial the court entered judgment for the landlord for $223,000, the rent due through July 1, 2022 when it regained possession, holding the tenant had been evicted (not abandoned) so the landlord could not recover post-possession rent; it denied the landlord's post-trial claim to $2,149,435.75 in actual damages. The Superior Court affirmed.
